reply.answer_text: When a surrender is paid 12 days late, we restore the customer's position. That means they receive: (1) the full surrender value due; (2) interest at 8% simple per year for the 12 days out of pocket (in this example, £52.60 on a £20,000 surrender); (3) a distress-and-inconvenience payment if the delay caused real disruption; and (4) a written apology explaining what went wrong and how we've fixed it. We deduct income tax from the interest where required and issue a tax deduction certificate.
